text: The paper reports that SGR is near 100% for model sizes between 7b and 70b, but that generalization declines somewhat across methods once the gap between train and test hardness becomes sufficiently large: for college STEM test questions with ICL, SGR falls from 74% when fitting to 8th grade questions to 57% when fitting to 3rd grade questions.
title: Easy-to-hard SGR stable across model scale but declines with large train-test hardness gap
